elements.content: Grammar focus: Present Tenses Review.

Ask whether the situation is permanent, temporary, continuing from the past, or still in progress. Permanent goes to the simple, temporary to the continuous, continuing with for or since to the perfect, and in progress up to now to the perfect continuous. Keep stative verbs out of the continuous.

present simple — habit, routine, permanent state: she works in Leeds
present continuous — now, around now, temporary: she is working from home this week
present perfect — experience, situation up to now: she has worked there since 2019
present perfect continuous — activity up to now, visible result: she has been working all morning
stative verbs — no continuous form: I know the answer, not I am knowing
timetables — present simple for schedules: the train leaves at 07:40
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Complete: 'I ___ here since 2020.'
2. Complete: 'She ___ the report at the moment.'
3. Which sentence is correct?
Read and listen: three examples in context.

He works in Leeds. — Permanent situation. (Present simple.)
He is working from home this week. — Temporary situation. (Present continuous.)
He has worked there since 2019. — Experience up to now. (Present perfect.)
What do you observe?

Present simple for habits, routines and permanent states (she works in Leeds, the train leaves at seven). Present continuous for actions happening now or around now, and for temporary situations (she is working from home this week). Present perfect for experience or a situation continuing to now, with for and since. Present perfect continuous for an activity that has been going on up to now, usually with a visible result.
1. Which tense marks a temporary situation?
2. Which tense goes with since 2019?
State the rule in one sentence, without looking at the table.
Freer production: I can edit a text for tense consistency.

Success criteria:
- I can keep permanent and temporary situations apart.
- I can use for and since with the present perfect.
- I can avoid the continuous with stative verbs.
Role play: put your position in ninety seconds; your partner notes every use of the target structure.
Frequent errors and correction:

❌ She is knowing the answer (continuous with a stative verb) → ✅ She knows the answer
❌ I work here since 2019 (present simple with since) → ✅ I have worked here since 2019
Correct these sentences: say what is wrong, then give the right version.
Acceptable variants:

The committee meets on the first Monday of the month.
The team is covering two regions while the post is vacant.
We have tested the system in three countries.
Adapt the same task to the group:

- Individual: five sentences with the structure, on the topic of the lesson.
- Pair: a ten-line dialogue where past tenses review carries the argument.
- Group: a six-minute debate, two sides, the structure required in every turn.
- Professional audience: transpose the structure into a memo.
- Academic audience: transpose it into a paragraph of analysis.
